idea.title: CostRadar — Real-time LLM API cost tracker across providers

plan.tagline: Automate overdue invoice follow-ups for freelancers with zero manual work.
plan.problem: Freelancers waste hours chasing late payments manually, losing revenue and productivity.
plan.solution: CLI tool that tracks invoices, sends automated polite reminders, and generates reports—all offline-first with SQLite.
plan.target_market: Solo developers, designers, and small business owners who invoice clients worldwide and hate chasing payments.
mvp_features: Auto-send email reminders via local SMTP
plan.demo_script: Run `invoicechase --demo` to see 3 mock invoices, auto-generated reminders, and a report showing $1,250 overdue—all without internet.
plan.phuket_angle: Thai freelancers (e.g., web devs, tour guides) often face late payments from expat clients—tool’s offline mode works great in Phuket’s spotty WiFi areas.
